testResults.name: focused-provider-tests
testResults.command: uv run --extra dev pytest -p no:cacheprovider tests/thesis/providers/
testResults.result: 30 tests (21 new): OpenRouter adapter (OpenAI-compatible payload with Authorization + HTTP-Referer/X-Title attribution headers, response parsing with usage, per-call key resolution from the injected EnvironmentKeySource with no key ever stored or serialized, fail-closed ProviderUnreachableError/ProviderRejectedError on network/401/429/5xx, preflight without credential exposure) and the FoundryDeploymentInvoker (deployment-bound chat-completions through the project endpoint with the Entra bearer from the credential protocol, composing the existing preflight snapshot); shared ModelInvocation records carry provider/model/version/role/request+response digests from an injected clock, and bind_role stamps the pre-result assignment with a deterministic assignment digest

testResults.name: wave-integration-suite
testResults.result: 2712 passed, 15 skipped, 1 xfailed at wave edit freeze

testResults.name: lint-and-type-gates
testResults.command: uv run --extra dev ruff check src/thesis/providers tests/thesis/providers && uv run --extra dev ty check src/thesis/providers
testResults.result: ruff, format, and ty clean; preflight surfaces untouched (append-only invoker)

limitations: Router binding is a recommendation: register adapters in the ModelRouter providers mapping keyed by profile provider, call bind_role before invoking, translate provider errors to the error:// provenance path, and record ModelInvocation through a shared InMemoryInvocationLedger
